/interface-screenshots/vmware-network-ed.label: Network list: select the lab VMnet. This vendor reference currently shows VMnet8; follow your lesson’s written values.
Choose the required network mode. A DMZ lab host-only network is different from the NAT example in this reference.

/dmz/references/firewall_rules_1.png.label: Select the intended ingress interface before reviewing its rules.
Add a narrow rule, then inspect its source, destination and port before applying.
Apply only after checking rule order and preserving administrator access.

/interface-screenshots/alma-software.png.label: Search finds an application by name. Follow the class’s package/source choice rather than installing an unrelated result.
Installed lists applications already present; Updates is the adjacent maintenance view.

/interface-screenshots/az-nsg-add-rule.p.label: Source: restrict it to the approved address or subnet in the lesson; do not copy the sample Any source.
Destination port: enter your lesson’s service port. The original reference shows an 8080 example.
Choose the required protocol explicitly; a web-only rule normally uses TCP.

/interface-screenshots/win-server-roles..label: The wizard is on Server Roles. Check the destination server before changing a role.
This original reference highlights Active Directory Domain Services. Select only the role named in your actual lesson.

/splunk/interface-02.png.label: Search bar: paste the class SPL here, not in PowerShell or the SONIC terminal.
Time picker: use All time for the class’s fixed-date CSV data unless the lesson asks for another range.

/splunk/interface-03.png.label: Use your CloudSeam search and index; the source image shows unrelated vendor tutorial data.
The time range controls which events the search can see.
Events shows records; Statistics and Visualization are used after suitable searches.
The Fields sidebar helps you discover the fields available in the current results.
Save As is where a suitable search can become a report or dashboard panel.

/splunk/interface-05.png.label: Choose Upload to ingest the exact event CSV named in the lesson. Lookup CSV files follow the separate Lookups workflow.
